messages.subject: [NEW BOOK] Bayesian Models for Astrophysical Data
parts:
Hi everyone, 

apologies for the spam.

I just wanted to call your attention that our new book on 
Bayesian models using Stan has been released.

https://www.bayesianmodelsforastrophysicaldata.com/

The book contains complete scripts which are publicly available at
https://github.com/astrobayes/BMAD

Although the final chapter shows examples of applications in astronomy, you do not need to be an astronomer to follow the text.

I hope you find this useful. 

emille


--
